review_setup_py: review the python setup.py to understand package dependencies and entry points for parlai
refactor_setup_py: refactor the python setup.py to update version or add new package dependencies
summarize_setup_py: summarize the python setup.py to identify install requirements and console script entry points
test_setup_py: test the python setup.py by running python setup.py check to validate package metadata
build_parlai_package: build the parlai python package using python setup.py sdist to create a source distribution
